explanation: This theorem is the generic `Equiv.apply_symm_apply` applied to `tensorHomEquiv`, an equivalence the library defines itself (SchemeProperties/ModuleTensor.lean:185). Mathlib has no `tensorHomEquiv` under Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry. A general equivalence law applied to the library's own definition does not count as duplicating Mathlib. All the mathematical content is in the library's definition, so I found no Mathlib declaration that this theorem duplicates.
